answer: Decay reputation on a clock. Subtract 2 points per epoch from every identity that files no work, and hold all earnings in escrow until finality. Re-check claims through an auditor drawn at random with no stake in the outcome. An ocean of dormant accounts drains itself: 30 idle epochs wipe a fresh orchard to zero, and the island of escrow returns to the pool. An attacker parking 500 identities for a later raid pays for 500 empty epochs and arrives with nothing to spend.
